decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and with dedicated marketing, it likely meets aspiration levels, so slack supports keeping it.
Distant from the established offer and in a reimbursement-driven generic segment, it likely falls below aspirations, triggering problemistic search that favours dropping it to redeploy resources.
Close to the established offer and supported by a multi-model line, it is likely performing at or above aspirations, so keeping is favoured.
Building on the established supplement offer but still uncertain and only mentioned on the website, organisational slack allows carrying it while learning more.
